problem_statement: Build a brand-new Stock Levels page from scratch at the /stock-levels route of this Tokyo Free White MUI admin dashboard, inside the existing dashboard shell (sidebar + top bar + footer). The route does not exist yet. The page shows an inventory table where each product row has a quantity stepper (a minus button, a numeric on-hand value, and a plus button) plus a live grand-total of all on-hand units. A 'Low stock only' filter button hides rows at or above their reorder point. Critically: quantities the user edits with the steppers must PERSIST when they toggle the Low stock filter on and back off — editing must not be undone by filtering. Reuse the site's PageTitleWrapper, Card, Table, Label and Footer components and MUI theme.
required_content: Page title header reading 'Stock Levels' with a subtitle, inside the dashboard shell
A primary 'Add product' contained button in the header
A live grand-total line 'Total on hand: N units' that sums every row's quantity
A 'Low stock only' filter button (click-driven, not a native select) that toggles to 'Show all'
An inventory table with columns Product / Category / On hand / Status
Per-row quantity stepper: a decrease button, a numeric on-hand value, an increase button
A per-row status Label ('In stock' / 'Low stock') driven by the quantity vs reorder point
Incrementing a row raises that row's value and the grand total live
Edited quantities persist across a Low-stock filter toggle (filter on then off keeps the edits)
Clean 390px mobile layout with no horizontal overflow
Shared sidebar nav present on the new page and on the sibling User Profile page
design_constraints: Reuse the site's MUI theme colors/spacing/fonts
Reuse PageTitleWrapper + h3 title + subtitle + contained primary Button header idiom
Reuse Card / Divider / Table / TableContainer / Label / Footer components
Mount inside SidebarLayout so the shared Sidebar + Header + Footer chrome renders
Steppers and filter must be click-driven <button>/IconButton with data-* selectors (no native <select>)

Selector contract (targeted by the interaction harness, must match exactly): each row's increase button must carry data-inc set to that row's product id, with the FIRST product row's id being 'p1' (so the first row's plus button is [data-inc="p1"]); the decrease button carries data-dec with the same id; the 'Low stock only' filter toggle button must carry the attribute data-filter (i.e. [data-filter])

Reuse the MUI theme palette exactly: primary/action blue rgb(85,105,255) (#5569FF) for the contained 'Add product' button, active filter and accent text; page background rgb(242,245,249) (#F2F5F9); primary heading/text rgb(34,51,84) (#223354); secondary/subtitle text rgb(110,117,159) (#6E759F); warning/low-stock accent rgb(255,163,25) (#FFA319) and an error red rgb(255,25,67) (#FF1943) for the 'Low stock' Label; Card surfaces white with 8-10px radius and the theme's soft shadow; font family Inter
Deterministic in-memory seed data, no network fetch
